audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Garen the First-item stage while its own why said the lane 'settles toward even'; packet flags the chart as contradicting a 52.26% Cho'Gath win rate over 1060 games.
audit.why: Garen genuinely owns levels 1 through 5 — Decisive Strike into Judgment out-damages anything Cho'Gath has pre-6. From Feast onward it evens out, and two items is Cho'Gath's.
audit.corrected: First item flipped to Skill: Garen / Garen / Garen / Garen / Skill / Skill / Cho'Gath.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level-6 phase text was the generic template — it named no ultimate and no cooldown, and the first-item phase pointed at the wrong cooldown.
audit.why: Feast is 80/70/60s, true damage and permanent max HP. Demacian Justice (120/100/80s) scales off the target's missing health, so every Feast stack pushes Cho'Gath's execute threshold further out of Garen's reach — that is the real level-6 story.
audit.corrected: Level 6 now names Feast's 80s and the Demacian Justice interaction; first item keyed to Decisive Strike being down.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every interaction field tracked Courage as 'matchup-defining' and described it only as 'damage reduction'. The decisive button is Decisive Strike, and its two relevant properties were never stated anywhere in the entry.
audit.why: Decisive Strike (Q, flat 8s, 300 range) both silences Cho'Gath — blanking the Feral Scream follow-up — and breaks free of all slows, which deletes the Rupture and Vorpal Spikes slows that are Cho'Gath's only stick. Courage (22/19.5/17/14.5/12s) is a shield plus tenacity, which shortens the Rupture knockup rather than preventing it. Riot's text also makes Decisive Strike an auto-attack empower, so the wind-up is the tell, not the cast.
audit.corrected: Decisive Strike (8s) silences you and clears Rupture's slow — bait it, then Q-W-Feast him.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Engage only on Courage's cooldown' pointed at the wrong cooldown.
audit.why: Courage is 22s at rank 1 but only mitigates; Decisive Strike at a flat 8s is what decides whether your combo connects.
audit.corrected: Focus target moved to Garen Decisive Strike (Q).

edits.before: W silence starts flipping his combo windows. Only take the trade when Garen's Courage is down.
edits.after: Decisive Strike (8s) silences you and breaks your slows — trade only in the window after he spends it.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Courage's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Trade around Decisive Strike, not Courage: 8s down means no silence and no slow-break, so your Rupture-into-Scream lands.

edits.before: Feast stacks turn you into terrain — every R is permanent HP plus a true-damage execute. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Garen's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Feast (80s) is permanent max HP and true damage — and every stack drags Demacian Justice's missing-health execute further out of his reach. Even now.

edits.before: Heartsteel is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Courage's cooldown.
edits.after: Heartsteel plus Feast stacks blunt his Q-E chip — force fights when Decisive Strike is down.

edits.before: Track Garen's Courage: Damage reduction. Trade when down. When it is down — Q-W + R him.
edits.after: Decisive Strike (8s) silences you and clears Rupture's slow — bait it, then Q-W-Feast him.

edits.before: - Garen Courage: matchup-defining — Damage reduction. Trade when down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Garen Decisive Strike: matchup-defining — 8s flat. It silences you and breaks every slow you apply, so it eats your combo. Courage (22s rank 1) is a shield plus tenacity. - Feast: kill windows only.

edits.before: Q under Garen's feet as he commits, W-silence the answer, and E-spike the trade — your sustain regens what his chip cost.
edits.after: Bait Decisive Strike, then Rupture under his feet, Feral Scream the answer and E-spike — with his Q down your slow actually holds.

edits.before: Land Rupture to open every trade and immediately chain Feral Scream's silence — but only when his Q is down, since a Q on you blanks the silence follow-up
edits.after: Land Rupture to open every trade and chain Feral Scream — but only when Decisive Strike is down 8s, since his Q silences you and breaks your slow

notes: Unverified and left alone: whether Rupture's knockup interrupts an active Judgment (E) spin. Riot's text does not say and I would not assert it. Packet listed 'Feral Scream's' and 'Feral Scream-' as probable wrong names — both false positives, they are the real name with punctuation attached. Cho'Gath kit flags Rupture as 'grounding'; Riot's description says it pops enemies into the air, so I wrote it as a knockup.
